Walk-in Interview – Visiting Faculty (Statistics)

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, a public sector university, requires the services of
visiting faculty
for semester
Fall – 2026
in the following disciplines. Interested/eligible candidates may appear through walk-in interview as per the following schedule:

 Interview Schedule

S. No | Discipline | No. of Visiting Faculty Required | Minimum Required Qualification | Venue & Time
1 | Statistics | 02 Positions | MPhil/MS in the relevant field from an HEC recognized University/Institution | Office of the Dean, Faculty of Physical & Numerical Sciences, Garden Campus, AWKUM

Date

September 01, 2026

Time

10:00 AM

Venue

Office of the Dean, Faculty of Physical & Numerical Sciences, Garden Campus, AWKUM

✎ Terms & Conditions

Applicants are required to fill the
Application Form (https://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/Forms/Job_Forms/Application_form_AWKUM-New.docx)
available on
www.awkum.edu.pk (https://www.awkum.edu.pk)
, along with their CVs, on the interview day.

Candidates shall bring original documents along with attested photocopies of all DMCs, Degrees, Certificates, Experience Certificate, CNIC and one recent passport size photograph.

The engagement shall be on visiting basis for one semester i.e. Fall – 2026.

The applicants are required to reach the mentioned venue on given date and time.

The engagement shall be governed by the terms & conditions to be mentioned in the letter of engagement.

The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of seats or not to fill the posts as per need.

No TA/DA shall be admissible for the interview.

Important:
Applicants must fill and bring the Application Form (available for download below) on the interview day, along with their CV and all required original/attested documents.

⬇ Download Application Form (https://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/Forms/Job_Forms/Application_form_AWKUM-New.docx)

 Visit AWKUM Website (https://www.awkum.edu.pk)
